input.title: Onboarding Guide - {{input.employee_name}}
input.content:
# Onboarding Guide for {{input.employee_name}}

## Employee Information
- **Name:** {{input.employee_name}}
- **Position:** {{input.position}}
- **Department:** {{input.department}}
- **Start Date:** {{input.start_date}}
- **Manager:** {{input.manager}}

## Welcome!

We're thrilled to have you join our team. This document contains all the information you need to get started.

## First Week Checklist
- [ ] Complete HR paperwork
- [ ] Set up your workstation
- [ ] Attend orientation session
- [ ] Meet with your manager
- [ ] Review company policies

## Resources
- Company handbook
- Team directory
- IT support contact

## Questions?

Feel free to reach out to your manager or HR team.
